scope: Supplement existing scored galleries at runtime without changing source scoring shards or 514 original photo references

photo.label: Lindheimer muhly — several mature narrow tan flowering panicles beside a hand for scale; true inner ligule and rooted crown not visible

Original family image-sources.csv lists Wendy A, individual CC0 source record, GBIF occurrence 6234431311, iNaturalist original photo 644375329. Do not infer local voucher or same-shoot ligule.
